stops.note: 'land of Ceredig', a 5th-century ruler said to be a son of Cunedda; its chief town was anglicised as Cardigan
after James Brudenell, 7th Earl of Cardigan, who led the Charge of the Light Brigade at Balaclava in 1854; the knitted wool waistcoats he and his officers wore took his title

current_meaning: a knitted sweater that fastens down the front
